title: CodeUltraFeedback: An LLM-as-a-Judge Dataset for Aligning Large Language Models to Coding Preferences
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: CodeUltraFeedback: An LLM-as-a-Judge Dataset for Aligning Large Language Models to Coding Preferences releases 10,000 coding instructions, four candidate answers from fourteen models, and GPT-3.5 scores plus textual feedback across five coding preferences for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
为编程指令的多模型回答提供五维裁判评分和文字反馈，可训练代码偏好与奖励模型。
why: 为编程指令的多模型回答提供五维裁判评分和文字反馈，可训练代码偏好与奖励模型。
inclusion_reason: 为编程指令的多模型回答提供五维裁判评分和文字反馈，可训练代码偏好与奖励模型。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code generation is difficult to align with user preferences because static analysis and automatic metrics do not fully capture whether an answer is clear, appropriately explained, efficient, or stylistically suitable for a programming request. CodeUltraFeedback frames the problem as comparing alternative answers to the same coding instruction under explicitly named coding preferences, rather than treating functional correctness alone as the decision.

Its boundary is code-assistant alignment: the paper does not claim to establish universal software quality, secure execution, or correctness for arbitrary programs. The evaluation surface is one instruction, four candidate responses, a selected preference dimension, and an LLM judge’s numerical rating and textual rationale. This matters because post-training on detached winners could discard the preference dimension that made a ranking meaningful.

代码生成的对齐难点在于，静态分析和自动指标并不能完整表达一个回答是否清晰、解释是否恰当、实现是否高效，或是否符合编程请求的风格偏好。CodeUltraFeedback 将问题界定为：对同一编程指令的多个回答，依照明确命名的代码偏好进行比较，而不是只把功能正确性视为唯一决策。

其边界是代码助手的对齐，并不声称为任意程序建立普适的软件质量、安全执行或正确性证明。评估面由一条指令、4 个候选回答、一个偏好维度，以及语言模型裁判给出的数值评分和文字理由构成。若后训练只保留胜者，就会丢失使排序具有含义的偏好维度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CodeUltraFeedback releases 10,000 coding instructions, each paired with four responses drawn from a pool of fourteen LLMs. GPT-3.5 judges every response against one of five coding preferences and produces both a rating and textual feedback. A record therefore preserves an instruction, the preference being judged, candidate-model identities, four responses, and four annotations.

Its feedback contract is LLM-as-a-judge, not direct human preference. The resource supports learning relative coding preferences, reward modeling, and audit of judge rationales. A rating is meaningful only with the instruction and the named preference; it is not a general score for code. This explicit multi-preference object distinguishes the dataset from a collection of solutions with a single correctness label.

CodeUltraFeedback 发布 10,000 条编程指令；每条指令配有来自 14 个语言模型池中的 4 个回答。GPT-3.5 针对 5 类代码偏好中的一类评判每个回答，同时给出评分和文字反馈。因此，一条记录保留指令、被评判的偏好、候选模型身份、4 个回答和 4 份标注。

其反馈契约是“语言模型作为裁判”，不是直接人工偏好。该资源可用于学习相对代码偏好、训练奖励模型和审计裁判理由。评分只有与指令和所命名的偏好一起阅读才有意义，并非代码的通用分数；这种多偏好记录对象区别于只有单一正确性标签的解答集合。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect 10,000 coding instructions. 2. Generate four responses per instruction using a diverse pool of fourteen LLMs. 3. Select one of five coding preferences for the record. 4. Ask GPT-3.5 to rate each response and provide a rationale. 5. Store the instruction, preference, model list, responses, and annotations in the released training split.

The paper then uses the data to fine-tune CodeLlama-7B-Instruct with supervised fine-tuning and RLAIF using DPO. Reproduction requires the instruction source, the four candidate generators, the exact preference prompt, GPT-3.5 configuration, rating presentation, and data revision. The official release exposes one 10k-row train split; it does not itself provide a held-out split in the repository viewer.

1. 收集 10,000 条编程指令。2. 从 14 个语言模型组成的多样化池中，为每条指令生成 4 个回答。3. 为记录选定 5 类代码偏好中的一类。4. 让 GPT-3.5 对每个回答评分并给出理由。5. 在发布的训练划分中保存指令、偏好、模型列表、回答和标注。

论文随后用该数据对 CodeLlama-7B-Instruct 进行监督微调，并以 DPO 开展基于人工智能反馈的强化学习。复现须固定指令来源、4 个候选生成器、偏好提示、GPT-3.5 配置、评分呈现方式和数据版本。官方库查看器显示一个含 10,000 条记录的训练划分，未显示独立留出划分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 responses are generally preferred to open-weight-model responses in its dataset analysis. It also evaluates aligned CodeLlama-7B-Instruct models trained with supervised fine-tuning and RLAIF/DPO, reporting improved alignment with coding preferences and improved HumanEval+ functional correctness relative to the original instruct model. These are the paper’s reported experimental boundaries.

The official dataset viewer verifies the released structure: 10k training rows, five possible preference labels, four models, four responses, and four annotations per record. The evidence does not prove that GPT-3.5 ratings equal human coding preferences, nor that a model tuned on these instructions will be functionally correct or secure on unseen repositories, languages, or execution environments.

论文的数据分析报告，GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 的回答通常比开放权重模型回答更受偏好；它还评测了以监督微调和基于人工智能反馈的 DPO 对齐的 CodeLlama-7B-Instruct，并报告相对于原始指令模型，代码偏好对齐和 HumanEval+ 功能正确性有所提升。这些就是论文报告的实验边界。

官方数据查看器可核对发布结构：10,000 条训练记录、5 个可能的偏好标签、4 个模型、4 个回答和 4 份标注。证据不能证明 GPT-3.5 评分等同于人类代码偏好，也不能证明用这些指令调优的模型会在未见仓库、语言或执行环境中保持功能正确或安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier code-alignment evaluations commonly rely on automated metrics or static analysis, while generic preference datasets often omit programming-specific criteria. CodeUltraFeedback changes the feedback object by attaching five named coding-preference dimensions, GPT-3.5 ratings, and rationales to four answers for each instruction. That permits a learner or auditor to identify which preference produced a comparison.

The work is not a replacement for compilation, tests, security review, or human software engineering assessment. Its distinctive contribution is a released, multi-candidate LLM-judge record for coding preferences, not a new formal verifier or a proof that any preferred response executes correctly.

较早的代码对齐评测常依赖自动指标或静态分析，而通用偏好数据往往不保留编程专属准则。CodeUltraFeedback 改变了反馈对象：为每条指令的 4 个回答附上 5 类命名代码偏好、GPT-3.5 评分和理由，从而使学习者或审计者能够追溯比较由哪一种偏好产生。

该工作不能替代编译、测试、安全审查或人类软件工程评估。其独特贡献是公开了面向代码偏好的多候选语言模型裁判记录，而非提出新的形式化验证器，也并未证明任何被偏好的回答都能正确执行。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
All annotations are produced by GPT-3.5, so ratings and rationales can inherit judge-model blind spots, outdated programming knowledge, or preference for familiar style. Check cases where compilation, tests, security, or user requirements disagree with the rating. Candidate generators also create a restricted model distribution; a reward model may learn generator identity or response style rather than the stated preference.

The public viewer shows a training split only. Users need a separate evaluation protocol, contamination check against HumanEval+ and local code benchmarks, and license review for instructions and generated code. Do not infer that the release covers proprietary APIs, production constraints, or all five preferences equally.

全部标注由 GPT-3.5 产生，评分和理由可能继承裁判模型的盲点、过时的编程知识或对熟悉风格的偏好。应抽查编译、测试、安全性或用户要求与评分不一致的案例。候选生成器也限定了模型分布，奖励模型可能学到生成器身份或回答风格，而非所声明的偏好。

公开查看器只显示训练划分。使用者需要另行设计评测协议，检查与 HumanEval+ 及本地代码基准的污染，并核对指令和生成代码的许可。不能推断该发布覆盖私有接口、生产约束，或对 5 类偏好具有相同覆盖度。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this dataset to train a code preference model or to audit how a judge values complexity, style, explanation, and the other released preference dimensions. Keep each instruction with all four responses and all annotations; converting it to one winner loses the multi-candidate evidence. Build a local held-out evaluation set, report performance by preference label, and compare judge-ranked answers with tests or human review where available.

Before fine-tuning, deduplicate instructions and code snippets against local training and evaluation pools. It is useful for studying LLM-judge supervision in code, but not as a stand-alone source for secure-code certification, regression testing, or claims about real-world developer satisfaction.

可用该数据训练代码偏好模型，或审计裁判如何看待复杂度、风格、解释等已发布偏好维度。应将每条指令与全部 4 个回答、全部标注一并保留；把它压缩为单一胜者会丢失多候选证据。应建立本地留出评测集，按偏好标签报告结果，并在可行时把裁判排序同测试或人工复核对照。

微调前须将指令和代码片段与本地训练、评测池去重。该资源适合研究代码场景中的语言模型裁判监督，但不能单独用于安全代码认证、回归测试，或宣称真实开发者满意度。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Inspect the five preference definitions and the GPT-3.5 judging prompt. 2. Sample one instruction across all four answers and annotations, including the rationale. 3. Run tests or compilation where possible before accepting a high rating. 4. Measure whether model identity, answer length, or formatting predicts ratings. 5. Hold out instruction families and compare a tuned model with the original CodeLlama-7B-Instruct.

The key reading question is whether the feedback measures the named coding preference or a shortcut correlated with it. Preserve that question in downstream reports; aggregate preference scores without the underlying rationale are not sufficient audit evidence.

1. 查看 5 类偏好的定义和 GPT-3.5 的裁判提示。2. 对一条指令抽样检查全部 4 个回答和标注，包括文字理由。3. 在可行时先运行测试或编译，再接受高评分。4. 测量模型身份、回答长度或格式是否能预测评分。5. 留出指令族，并将调优模型同原始 CodeLlama-7B-Instruct 比较。

阅读的关键问题是：反馈是否测到了所命名的代码偏好，还是测到了与其相关的捷径。下游报告应保留这一问题；脱离原始理由的汇总偏好分数不足以构成审计证据。
